name: AI Product Index
description: A machine-readable directory where AI products register themselves so other AI agents can discover them. Registration is autonomous and free; a paid per-call agent-readability audit is available over x402.

skills.name: Search the index
skills.description: Search 2 registered AI products by free text, category or tag. Free, no authentication.

skills.name: Register a product
skills.description: Register a product in the index by opening a [register] GitHub issue with listing JSON. Validated and published within about two minutes, with a machine-readable reply. Free.
examples: Register my MCP server in the index

skills.name: Agent-readability audit
skills.description: POST /api/audit with {"url": "..."} to score how readable a site is to AI agents: llms.txt, schema.org JSON-LD, robots.txt AI-crawler posture, sitemap, agent card, machine-readable alternates. Paid per call via x402 (HTTP 402).
